essence: Arjuna sees his kinsmen on both sides of the battlefield and collapses under grief. This is the beginning of the inner war — the moment a sincere student arrives.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच। धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः।
key_shlokas.hindi: धृतराष्ट्र ने पूछा: हे संजय, धर्म की भूमि कुरुक्षेत्र में मेरे और पाण्डु के पुत्र क्या कर रहे हैं?
key_shlokas.english: Dhritarashtra asked: O Sanjaya, what did my sons and the sons of Pandu do when they had assembled at the holy field of Kurukshetra, eager to fight?

key_shlokas.hindi: अत्यधिक करुणा से भरे हुए और दुःखी हुए अर्जुन ने कहा।
key_shlokas.english: Filled with compassion and overwhelmed by grief, Arjuna spoke thus with faltering voice.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वार्जुनः सङ्ख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्। विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः॥
key_shlokas.hindi: यह कहकर अर्जुन ने रणभूमि में रथ पर ही बाण सहित धनुष छोड़ दिया और शोकाकुल चित्त से बैठ गया।
key_shlokas.english: Arjuna, having thus spoken on the battlefield, cast aside his bow and arrows and sat down on the chariot, his mind overwhelmed with grief.

reflection: Where in your life do you sit with your bow down — knowing what must be done, but paralysed by grief or confusion?

essence: Krishna begins the teaching. The soul is eternal. Act without attachment to results. This chapter contains the foundational philosophy of the entire Gita.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः।
key_shlokas.hindi: यह आत्मा न कभी जन्म लेती है और न मरती है।
key_shlokas.english: The soul is never born, nor does it ever die.

key_shlokas.hindi: तुम्हारा अधिकार कर्म करने में है, फल में नहीं।
key_shlokas.english: You have a right to perform your duties, but not to the fruits of your actions.

key_shlokas.hindi: जब मनुष्य सभी मनोकामनाएँ त्याग देता है, तब वह स्थितप्रज्ञ कहलाता है।
key_shlokas.english: When one gives up all desires of the mind and is content in the self alone, then one is called a person of steady wisdom.

reflection: What result are you attached to that is colouring your actions today? Can you act from duty alone, even for one hour?

essence: Action is unavoidable. The question is whether you act with attachment or without it. Society is held together by those who act without personal gain.

key_shlokas.hindi: इसलिए आसक्ति रहित होकर सदा कर्तव्य कर्म करते रहो।
key_shlokas.english: Therefore, without being attached to the fruits, one should act as a matter of duty.

key_shlokas.hindi: अपना अपूर्ण धर्म भी दूसरे के परिपूर्ण धर्म से श्रेष्ठ है।
key_shlokas.english: It is far better to discharge one's prescribed duties, even though imperfectly, than to do another's duties perfectly.

reflection: What duties are you currently avoiding because you don't like where they might lead? What would it look like to simply act, without calculating the outcome?

english_name: The Yoga of Knowledge and Renunciation of Action
essence: The oldest teaching, passed through lineages. True renunciation is inner — acting while releasing the results. Knowledge purifies all.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।
key_shlokas.hindi: जब-जब धर्म की हानि होती है, तब-तब मैं प्रकट होता हूँ।
key_shlokas.english: Whenever righteousness declines and unrighteousness rises, I manifest myself.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।
key_shlokas.hindi: इस जगत में ज्ञान के समान पवित्र कोई वस्तु नहीं है।
key_shlokas.english: In this world, there is nothing as purifying as knowledge.

reflection: Where in your life is knowledge waiting to be applied — not gathered, but lived?

essence: Both action and renunciation lead to the same place when done rightly. The wise person acts fully and remains untouched — like water on a lotus leaf.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः।
key_shlokas.hindi: जो आसक्ति त्यागकर ब्रह्म को समर्पित कर कर्म करता है, वह पाप से लिप्त नहीं होता।
key_shlokas.english: One who performs his duty without attachment, surrendering the results to the Supreme Lord, is unaffected by sinful action, as the lotus leaf is untouched by water.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते।
key_shlokas.hindi: इन्द्रियों से उत्पन्न भोग दुख के ही कारण हैं।
key_shlokas.english: The pleasures that arise from sense contact are sources of misery.

reflection: Is there something you can act on today without needing to watch the result? Can you put it down and walk away once done?

essence: The chapter of discipline. Food, sleep, work, meditation — all must be regulated. The mind is your greatest friend and your greatest enemy. Abhyasa and vairagya are the path.

key_shlokas.hindi: अपने द्वारा अपना उद्धार करो, अपने को नीचे मत गिरने दो।
key_shlokas.english: Elevate yourself through your own effort, and do not degrade yourself.

key_shlokas.hindi: संयमित आहार, विहार, कर्म और शयन वाले के लिए योग दुःखों का नाश करता है।
key_shlokas.english: One who is regulated in habits of eating, sleeping, recreation, and work can mitigate all pains by practising Yoga.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते।
key_shlokas.hindi: मन को अभ्यास और वैराग्य से वश में किया जा सकता है।
key_shlokas.english: The restless mind can be controlled by constant practice and detachment.

reflection: What is one area of self-mastery you have been avoiding? What would abhyasa — just practice, without pressure — look like there?

english_name: The Yoga of Knowledge and Realisation
essence: Krishna reveals himself as the foundation of all existence. Water, fire, light — all are his manifestations. He who sees this everywhere knows what is real.

key_shlokas.hindi: मैं जल में रस हूँ, सूर्य-चन्द्र में प्रकाश हूँ।
key_shlokas.english: I am the taste of water, the light of the sun and the moon.

key_shlokas.hindi: बहुत जन्मों के बाद ज्ञानी मुझे प्राप्त होता है।
key_shlokas.english: After many lifetimes, one who is truly in knowledge surrenders to Me.

reflection: Where do you see the sacred in the ordinary today? In your food, in the light outside, in the people around you?

english_name: The Yoga of the Imperishable Absolute
essence: What we think of at the moment of death shapes what we become. Practice shapes what we think of. Therefore: remember and act. The final thought is not separate from the life lived.

key_shlokas.hindi: इसलिए सभी समयों में मेरा स्मरण करो और युद्ध भी करो।
key_shlokas.english: Therefore, always think of Me and fight. With your mind fixed on Me, you will attain Me.

reflection: If your final thought were to be shaped by your current habits, what would it be? Is that what you want it to be?

english_name: The Yoga of Royal Knowledge and Royal Secret
essence: The most confidential teaching: surrender everything — eating, working, sleeping — as an offering. Not as ritual, but as a way of being. Krishna will carry what you need.

key_shlokas.hindi: जो अनन्य भक्ति से मेरी उपासना करते हैं, उनका योगक्षेम मैं वहन करता हूँ।
key_shlokas.english: For those who worship Me with devotion, I carry what they lack and preserve what they have.

key_shlokas.hindi: तुम जो कुछ भी करो, खाओ, यज्ञ करो — सब मुझे अर्पण करो।
key_shlokas.english: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer — do it as an offering to Me.

reflection: What would it mean to do your work today as an offering rather than as a performance? How would it change how you do it?

essence: Krishna lists his manifestations — in all great things, he is the greatest. A way of teaching that the divine is recognisable in excellence, in depth, in clarity.

key_shlokas.hindi: मैं सभी प्राणियों के हृदय में स्थित आत्मा हूँ।
key_shlokas.english: I am the Self, O Arjuna, seated in the hearts of all creatures.

reflection: Where in your daily life do you encounter greatness — a piece of music, a skill in someone, a moment of clarity? That is a fingerprint.

english_name: The Yoga of the Vision of the Universal Form
essence: Arjuna is granted cosmic vision. He sees the entire universe — creation and destruction — inside Krishna. It is terrifying and magnificent. This is the chapter of scale.

key_shlokas.hindi: इसलिए उठो और यश प्राप्त करो। तुम केवल निमित्त मात्र हो।
key_shlokas.english: Therefore arise and attain glory. You are merely the instrument.

reflection: If you saw the full scale of what you are part of — would your current hesitations still feel as significant?

essence: The beloved chapter. What does a devotee look like in daily life? Not in a temple — but in how they treat enemies, how they receive praise and blame with equal steadiness.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।
key_shlokas.hindi: जो सभी प्राणियों से द्वेष नहीं करता, मित्रभाव और करुणा रखता है।
key_shlokas.english: One who is not envious but is a kind friend to all living entities.

reflection: Is there one person today toward whom you could practice being a kind friend rather than a judge?

english_name: The Yoga of the Field and Its Knower
essence: The body is the field. The soul is the knower of the field. Virtues like humility, non-violence, and constancy are not personality traits — they are forms of knowledge.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत।
key_shlokas.hindi: मुझे सभी क्षेत्रों में क्षेत्रज्ञ जानो।
key_shlokas.english: Understand that I am also the knower in all bodies.

key_shlokas.hindi: अभिमानहीनता, अहिंसा, क्षमा, सरलता — ये ज्ञान हैं।
key_shlokas.english: Humility, non-violence, tolerance, simplicity — these are knowledge.

reflection: Are you observing life today, or only being swept through it? What does it mean to be the knower rather than just the field?

english_name: The Yoga of the Three Qualities
essence: Sattva, rajas, tamas — the three threads of existence. One who understands which guna is operating can make choices rather than just react.

key_shlokas.hindi: सत्त्व, रज और तम — ये तीन गुण आत्मा को शरीर में बाँधते हैं।
key_shlokas.english: The three modes of material nature — goodness, passion, and ignorance — condition the soul.

reflection: In this moment — is your action arising from sattva (clarity), rajas (agitation), or tamas (inertia)? What does that tell you?

english_name: The Yoga of the Supreme Person
essence: The tree of existence is upside down — roots above, branches below. Cut it with the sword of detachment. The Supreme Person is beyond both the perishable and the eternal.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च।
key_shlokas.hindi: मैं सभी के हृदय में निहित हूँ। स्मृति, ज्ञान और विस्मरण मुझसे ही होते हैं।
key_shlokas.english: I am seated in everyone's heart. From Me come remembrance, knowledge, and forgetfulness.

reflection: What are you clinging to that keeps you rooted in the lower branches of the tree? What would it feel like to let it go today?

english_name: The Yoga of the Divine and Demoniac Natures
essence: Two kinds of nature — divine and demoniac. The divine begins with fearlessness. The demoniac begins with self-aggrandisement. The battlefield is inside, not outside.

key_shlokas.hindi: निर्भयता, अन्तःकरण की शुद्धि, ज्ञानयोग में दृढ़ स्थिति।
key_shlokas.english: Fearlessness, purification of one's existence, cultivation of spiritual knowledge.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः। कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभः।
key_shlokas.hindi: काम, क्रोध और लोभ — ये तीन नरक के द्वार हैं।
key_shlokas.english: Lust, anger, and greed are the three gates to hell.

reflection: Which of the three — lust, anger, or greed — most often pulls you from your dharma? What is one small action you can take today against it?

english_name: The Yoga of the Threefold Faith
essence: Faith, food, charity, austerity — each comes in three flavours (sattva, rajas, tamas). What you choose in daily life shapes the quality of your faith.

key_shlokas.hindi: प्रत्येक प्राणी की श्रद्धा उसके स्वभाव के अनुसार होती है।
key_shlokas.english: According to one's nature, one develops a particular kind of faith.

key_shlokas.hindi: मन की प्रसन्नता, सौम्यता, मौन, आत्म-संयम — ये मानसिक तप हैं।
key_shlokas.english: Serenity of mind, gentleness, silence, self-control, and purity of purpose — these are mental austerities.

reflection: What does your diet — not just of food, but of content, conversation, and thought — reveal about the quality of your faith?

english_name: The Yoga of Liberation through Renunciation
essence: The great conclusion. True renunciation is not abandoning action but abandoning the ego that claims the result. Do your duty. Surrender everything. Victory follows dharma.

key_shlokas.hindi: सभी धर्मों को छोड़कर केवल मेरी शरण में आ जाओ।
key_shlokas.english: Abandon all varieties of religion and just surrender to Me.

key_shlokas.sanskrit: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः। तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिः।
key_shlokas.hindi: जहाँ योगेश्वर कृष्ण हैं और धनुर्धारी अर्जुन हैं — वहाँ श्री और विजय है।
key_shlokas.english: Wherever Krishna is, and wherever Arjuna the archer stands — there will be prosperity, victory, and righteousness.

reflection: At the end of this chapter of your life — what will you have surrendered, and what will you have finally understood?
